author: Booker T. Washington
title: Character Building: Being Addresses Delivered on Sunday Evenings to the Students of Tuskegee Institute
edition: New York: Doubleday, Page & Company, 1902; copyright 1902, published June 1902, as stated in the transcribed title and copyright pages. Project Gutenberg eBook 60484. Original English text, paragraph boundaries preserved and line-wrap whitespace normalized; page-number markup excluded.

rights.basis: The downloaded title and copyright pages identify the New York publication and June 1902 publication date. This original English text predates 1931 and its US term has expired. Project Gutenberg explicitly marks this edition Public domain in the USA.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg 60484 HTML from the PG mirror aleph.pglaf.org, converted with a scratch walker over Washington's PREFACE (with its signature and place lines) and the addresses from the CHARACTER BUILDING half-title to LAST WORDS; the PG header and footer, title page, Publishers' Explanation and contents are left out, as is page-number markup. The edition's one footnote (on the occasion of Education That Educates) stays where the transcription places it, at the end of that address after a FOOTNOTE: paragraph label, in the form [Footnote 1: text], with its [1] anchor kept at the end of the address title. Italic and small-capital styling dropped and line-wrap whitespace joined; the book title is a level-1 heading (the half-title is not repeated), the Preface and each address title are level-2 headings, and the quoted spirituals are stanzas with lines trimmed.
